scope: Actual full boat and landing triangle surfaces in pier-local coordinates, prescribed boat yaw offset .08 and translation(3.9,.02,4.4), landing translation Z11. Triangle AABB pairs under .8m; vertex-face and edge-edge closest features. Static geometry only, no motion/rope/physics proof.
coplanar_limit: No overlapping AABB pairs if zero; otherwise coplanar triangle intersections are not separately classified.
